service.en: Pay parking reservation and utilisation violation fines
service.ar: سداد غرامات مخالفات حجز واستخدام المواقف
service.ur: پارکنگ ریزرویشن اور استعمال کی خلاف ورزی کے جرمانے کی ادائیگی
service.ml: പാർക്കിംഗ് റിസർവേഷൻ, ഉപയോഗ ലംഘന പിഴകൾ അടയ്ക്കൽ

about: Companies pay fines for reserving or using parking spaces for business without a permit or against its conditions.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: No additional costs beyond the fines
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
